messages:
mira: Quick sync — brought up klystron-15b (gguf int4) on canary pool, seeing weird steady-state mem churn and occasional 1s spikes in tail latency. initial perf:
mira: baseline host config: p4d, batch_size=8, max_new_tokens=256, kv_prefetch=on
mira: perf numbers (pp50/pp95 token latency): 9ms / 120ms; cost looks fine, but p99 spikes to 450ms on longer contexts (~3k tokens)
devon: hmm, those p99s smell like KV cache thrash + kernel scheduling. any OOM logs?
mira: no hard OOMs, just GPU mem usage oscillates +/- 1.2GB over long runs. suspect allocation churn / fragmentation.
alex: did you try lowering max_new_tokens to 128 for the canary? that reduced our similar spikes on lyra22b last month
mira: pushed a quick canary: max_new_tokens=128, batch_size=6, kv_prefetch=partial. running a 1h synthetic trace now. will post results.
ci-bot: perf-job #8421 started: suite=klystron-15b/canary, concurrency=64, trace=prod-sample-031
sato: for quant int4 sometimes GEMM path scatters memory. which quant backend? sm75-int4 or custom kernel?
mira: using our default quant pipeline (q4_0 fallback path) — compiled with kernelset v3.2. devon, can you try q4_1 kernelset on one node?
devon: will try q4_1 on node p4d-12 tomorrow morning. also will enable kv_eviction=aggressive for that test
lina: on quality side, we saw a tiny regressed BLEU on long-form summarization when we switched to q4_0 on klystron. is that reproducible here?
mira: yes small regression (~0.6 BLEU) vs float32 baseline on our eval set. quality-monitor flagged it after the initial rollout.
alex: can we run an A/B: q4_0 vs q4_1 with identical prompts and seeds? if q4_1 restores quality, we prefer it despite slight perf cost
mira: started A/B run (same synthetic and real traffic samples). logs:

```
ci-bot: ab-run #8421-A started
ci-bot: variantA=q4_0, variantB=q4_1
ci-bot: samples=2000
```

ci-bot: ab-run #8421-A finished — q4_1 restored BLEU by +0.7, p95 latency up ~6%
sato: okay that points to kernel numeric differences. if p99 spikes are due to eviction, try increasing slot-reserve to 0.15
mira: tried slot-reserve=0.15 + small prefetch window shrink. p95 improved to 115ms, p99 spikes reduced to ~300ms. mem churn amplitude down to ~400MB
devon: good. are we still seeing delayed GC-like drops in free memory? if so, we should enable defrag-on-idle
mira: observed a periodic 12-minute drop in free mem correlating with background compaction job. ops-bot, was there a maintenance task scheduled?
ops-bot: maintenance: nvlink-health-check scheduled at 10:40 UTC, ran on canary pool at 10:44, duration 18s — no reboots
lina: could nvlink checks cause transient CUDA syncs and make the tail blow up? probably not full 450ms but maybe contributes
alex: proposed rollout: keep q4_1 on canary + slot-reserve=0.15, max_new_tokens=128, batch_size=6. monitor 24h then promote
mira: agree. open question: default max_new_tokens for this family — 128 seems safer for tail, but increases token fragmentation across short requests. thoughts?
devon: from cost perf, 128 default reduces bloat for long traces. maybe keep 128 but expose per-customer override
sato: we should also add a gating rule in router: if request context > 1500 tokens, route to float32 pool (higher mem) to avoid repeated evictions
mira: added router rule in staging config. snippet:

```
route:
  - match: context_tokens > 1500
    target_pool: float32_highmem
    fallback: canary_quant
```

ci-bot: config-apply #291 queued
mira: next steps: 1) promote q4_1 + slot-reserve 0.15 on canary 2) keep max_new_tokens=128 default for klystron family 3) add router gating for long contexts 4) run 24h perf and quality sweep
lina: I'll watch quality dashboards and run stricter rouge/bleu subsets overnight
devon: I'll run q4_1 perf sweep across different batch sizes (4/6/8) and note mem churn
sato: I'll evaluate whether enabling defrag-on-idle yields additional stability (small perf hit)
alex: ping me when canary reaches 12h; I'll coordinate Dedicated config for next week
mira: thanks all — keeping this thread for updates. will post interim metrics. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: perf-job #8421 ended: avg p95=115ms, p99=310ms, BLEU_delta(q4_1 vs f32)= -0.1
mira: ack, will circle back with more granular token-length breakdowns by EOD"
